scope: Standalone matching-delta evidence validator and comparison script. No native operations and no benchmark results were generated by this check.

validation.coverage: Complete 36+9-row fixture; duplicate repeats; per-label regression hidden by unchanged aggregate recall; fallback, candidate-count and sequence mismatch; changed catalog/WAL and unbound source hash; zero/nonfinite proof margin.

contract.unpruned: Exactly four delta phases 0/100/1000/10000, L60/64/144, three repeats; verified matching-far-vector proof, durable batch counts, phase sequences, immutable base and admission metadata.
contract.optimized: Query-only log at the same final index/sequence, L60/64/144, three repeats; source archive and view hashes distinct from baseline.
contract.identity: Local log and archive hashes verified; view.rs hashed directly inside frozen archives; native binary, CURRENT, catalog and WAL hashes are separately collected host declarations, required to identify the same index before/after.
contract.quality: Integer strict-ID hit counts unchanged for every label and breadth across all repeats, phases and versions. Invalid, duplicate, short and fallback counts must be zero. Delta candidates equal size times query count.
contract.timing: Native io_uring, bypass cache, full worker warmup, public_snapshot_search_call and authoritative timing required. Compare query repeat medians; process resources, build, compilation and insert batches do not enter comparisons.
contract.limits: Synthetic all-255 vectors match every queried natural label. Inserts finish before query phases; no sustained concurrent-write or production SLA claim.
